title: Auto-review pipeline — builder finishes → reviewer auto-spawns → tests + code check → Done or Needs Fix
description: After a build agent completes, automatically spawn a short-lived reviewer process that: 1) Runs tests 2) Reads the git diff 3) Checks for obvious issues 4) Verdict: APPROVED → Done, or NEEDS FIX → back to builder with notes. Not a permanent agent — a pipeline step that spawns and dies. Like factory QC station.
routingReason: Standard coding task — GPT 5.4 is the implementation workhorse for factory builds
buildOutput:
`git diff HEAD~1`, `npm test`, check for bugs, output a structured verdict
- `parseReviewVerdict()` — parses `VERDICT: APPROVED` or `VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX` + notes from reviewer output; defaults to APPROVED if unparseable (so reviewer failures never block the pipeline)
- `finalizeReview()` — handles verdict: APPROVED applies the normal done/review transition; NEEDS_FIX sets `buildError` to reviewer notes and re-queues the builder
- `spawnReviewProcess()` — spawns `claude --model sonnet --print <prompt>` in the project dir; tracks it in the build log with `agentType: "reviewer"`
- `finalizeBuild()` modified — on success, spawns reviewer instead of immediately transitioning status; `task.codeReviewState = "pending"` while reviewer runs; queue advancement delayed until reviewer finishes

**`src/app/(dashboard)/factory/page.tsx`** — UI:
- `codeReviewState` added to Task interface
- `"reviewing"` added to AgentSprite status union
- Workshop Floor sprites show **"reviewing..."** with purple glow while reviewer runs (distinct from green "building..." and blue "awaiting review")

### Build log entries
Review builds appear with `agentType: "reviewer"` and `executionKey: "${key}:review"` — visible in the build log but isolated from the builder serialization queue.

### Caveat
If a task has review tags (ui, money, etc.), the auto-reviewer runs first; if it approves, the task then enters the human review queue as before. The auto-review is a pre-filter, not a replacement for human review.
